evidence_items.explanation: The report supports the substance of the report-content component: it reports no systematic unemployment increase among highly exposed workers and describes actual coverage as below theoretical capability. It also reports tentative evidence of slower hiring among young workers, so its unemployment result is not a finding of no possible employment effects.

This article explicitly distinguishes current employment findings from potential future disruption. It contradicts the characterization for this example, but cannot exclude misleading coverage elsewhere.
